2567: Sun is the daughter of mermaid Yakuza Seto Group's boss, Seto Gozaburo. She is a firm believer in the chivalrous spirit of mermaids, and is devoted to her role as Nagasumi's wife.
2568: A member of the Seto Group. Masa is the one who stole Nagasumi's first kiss (he was actually performing CPR, but anyone would use that as an excuse to say they got a kiss from a man as beautiful as him).
2625: "Spiral Shell" Maki is an assassin working for the Seto Group, as well a devoted friend of Sun. She, like Gōzaburō Seto, dislikes the idea of "losing" Sun to Nagasumi, and will often distract Sun with sweet talk in order to fire her shell gun at Nagasumi.
2632: Nagasumi is the protagonist of the story. Nagasumi is likely the only one in his family who has a clear head, apart from his grandmother. When push comes to shove, Nagasumi demonstrates large inner strength. (Wikipedia)
2633: Ren is San's mother. She likes to encourage San and Nagasumi, and usually tries to keep her husband in check. She also enjoys teasing Nagasumi, whom she thinks to be cute. She transfers to Nagasumi's school later on, becoming the new school nurse.
2757: Lunar is a childhood friend and rival of Sun. She has used the powers of her mermaid voice to become a pop star idol singer. She seems to suffer from a superiority complex, and she never passes up an attempt to overshadow Sun.
2831: Mawari is the daughter of the chief of police in Nagasumi's hometown, and a childhood friend of Nagasumi, who she has a crush on. She takes it upon herself to act as a moderator of social behavior, and often reprimands Nagasumi for some of his actions.
2886: Shark is a member of Seto Group initially summoned by Sun's father during the Michishio family's initial visit to the Seto family home to attack Nagasumi. In human form, he later becomes Nagasumi's P.E. teacher.
3739: Kai is the richest boy in Japan, the son of the head of the multi-million dollar Mikawa Corporation. He rivals Nagasumi for Sun's hand in marriage. He is a killer whale from another mermaid group.
5426: He is only referred to as Luna's Papa, he is Luna's father and leader of the Edomae group. He is a tall, very well built man dressed in a shiny black jump suit.
5580: She is a good friend of Mawari. While her true name is unknown, her classmates only refer her as Iinchou. Despite the fact that she is the class president, her presence is usually too passive to be noticeable. She also has a crush on Nagasumi.
6180: Seto Gouzaburou is Seto Sun's extremely over-protective and loving father. Head of the mermaid Yazuka in the Seto reigion, Gouzaburou is fierce and powerful.
6181: Hideyoshi Sarutobi, often referred to as Saru, is a friend of Nagasumi who is often portrayed as a perverted monkey. He later became Kai's "servant" and always protects and helps him when he is in need (although reasons are more likely because of his fortune).
6182: Nakajima is a member of Seto Group. As a very minor supporting character, not much is known about him, except his human transformation is weaker than the others, as can be seen in numerous scenes where he accidentally turns back into his octopus form.
7471: Akeno is not only a mermaid but also a "mermaid examiner". She has the responsibility of deporting all the mer-people who fail to qualify as not only resembling humans but also not arousing any suspicion of their true identities.
12603: She is Nagasumi's young-looking mother. She moons over Masa all the time and enjoys ignoring her husband. She approves of Nagasumi and Sun's relationship.
12604: Yoshiuo appears at the very end of the anime. He has his own mermaid gang and he kidnaps Sun and prepares to marry her against her will when Nagasumi bursts into Yoshiuo's lair to save her. He uses a special gas to paralyze people
12607: Nagasumi's father is always shown as an object of suffering, due to his wife's dying love for Masa.
64445: This is the grandmother of the main character Michishio, Nagasumi and mother to Michishio, Father
